 # Wire constant: the deflate bit promises a 4 KB window (OTA_INFLATE_WINDOW_SIZE)

+# Asks for deflate in place of CLIENT_FEATURE_SUPPORTS_DEFLATE for an RTL8710B
+# image. 2026.10 firmware does not know it: there an upstream issue corrupts a
+# deflate upload into OTA2 and makes it the boot image (esphome#22012)
+CLIENT_FEATURE_SUPPORTS_DEFLATE_RTL8710B = 0x40
+_UF2_MAGIC_HEAD = (0x0A324655).to_bytes(4, "little") + (0x9E5D5157).to_bytes(
+    4, "little"
+)
+_UF2_FAMILY_RTL8710B = 0x22E0D6FC
+RTL8710B_DEFLATE_NOTICE = (
+    "Uploading uncompressed, so this OTA takes longer: the device did not accept "
+    "a compressed upload. On RTL8710B this is expected while it runs ESPHome "
+    "2026.10, because of an upstream issue "
+    "(https://github.com/esphome/esphome/issues/22012); once this update is "
+    "installed, later OTAs are compressed again."
+)
+
+
+def _is_rtl8710b_image(image: bytes) -> bool:
+    """Whether the image is a LibreTiny UF2 for the RTL8710B (AmebaZ)."""
+    return (
+        len(image) >= 32
+        and image[:8] == _UF2_MAGIC_HEAD
+        and int.from_bytes(image[8:12], "little") & 0x2000 != 0
+        and int.from_bytes(image[28:32], "little") == _UF2_FAMILY_RTL8710B
+    )
+

+def _uf2_image(family: int, flags: int = 0x2000) -> bytes:
+    header = struct.pack("<8I", 0x0A324655, 0x9E5D5157, flags, 0, 256, 0, 1, family)
+    return header + b"firmware" * 100
+

+        (_uf2_image(0x22E0D6FC, flags=0), False),
+        (b"\xe9" + bytes(31), False),
+    ],
+    ids=["rtl8710b", "rtl8720c", "no-family", "esp"],
+)

+    assert espota2._is_rtl8710b_image(image) is expected

+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("mock_time")
+def test_perform_ota_rtl8710b_deflate_with_fixed_firmware(
+    mock_socket: Mock, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
+) -> None:
+    """An RTL8710B image asks for deflate with the bit only fixed firmware knows."""
+    original_content = _uf2_image(0x22E0D6FC)
+    mock_socket.recv.side_effect = (
+        _no_auth_handshake(
+            espota2.OTA_VERSION_2_0, espota2.SERVER_FEATURE_SUPPORTS_DEFLATE
+        )
+        + _UPLOAD_TAIL
+    )
+
+    espota2.perform_ota(mock_socket, None, io.BytesIO(original_content), "test.uf2")
+
+    sent = [c[0][0] for c in mock_socket.sendall.call_args_list]
+    assert sent[1][0] & espota2.CLIENT_FEATURE_SUPPORTS_DEFLATE_RTL8710B
+    assert not sent[1][0] & espota2.CLIENT_FEATURE_SUPPORTS_DEFLATE
+    assert zlib.decompress(sent[6], -espota2.DEFLATE_WINDOW_BITS) == original_content
+    assert espota2.RTL8710B_DEFLATE_NOTICE not in caplog.text
+
+
